Priya Rao: Heads-up — NebulaWorks renewal in ~6 weeks and we saw a P95 latency spike overnight. Could be a risk to renewal if not addressed. Thinking a short playbook: int8 quantization + swap to a smaller renew-friendly model for chat flows + routing short queries to a cached low-latency lane. Thoughts?
Nate (CS-bot): [ALERT] NebulaWorks: p95 latency 03:12 UTC jumped from 720ms -> 980ms, error rate +1.2% (span: inference.kv_cache_miss).
Alex Chen: Looking at traces now. Lots of KV cache misses and a fat tail of long-sequence calls (~>2048). Quick wins: enable int8 quant for the LLM weight pack + add a routing rule to send requests <512 tokens to cached endpoint. Also consider swapping heavy chat model to a distilled 7B instr variant for user-facing flows.
Diego Morales: Agree. I'll draft a canary rollout plan. Basic idea: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 24h with auto-rollbacks on error or p95 regressions. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token/sec, cost per 1M tokens. Example canary snippet:```yaml
canary:
  phases:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 20
      duration: 2h
    - pct: 50
      duration: 24h
monitoring:
  alerts:
    - cpu/oom
    - latency.p95 > baseline * 1.2
    - error_rate > baseline + 0.5%```
Priya Rao: Nice. Also want a short ROI blurb for renewal deck: int8 quant -> ~30-40% token compute cost reduction depending on model; swapping to distilled 7B for UI flows -> ~40-50% reduction in cost and typically a 20-60ms p95 improvement. I can surface those numbers in the renewal play.
Alex Chen: Can we also add a fallback route to the high-priority hosted pool (for 1-5% traffic) so if the canary model hits OOMs or lat spikes, we fail over gracefully? Add a circuit-breaker on p95 > threshold.
Diego Morales: I'll add a feature flag and routing rule in the config: `feature_flags: {nebula_lowlatency_pool: true}` and the route rule `if tokens < 512 -> route: lowlatency-cache` else standard.
Priya Rao: I'll coordinate with Leah (NebulaWorks CS lead) for an enablement sync tomorrow 10:00am PDT and share a one-pager. Checklist I'll send: preflight perf test script, canary plan, rollback steps, billing impact note, and a short eval prompt set. @Alex Chen can you prepare the baseline dashboards/widgets? :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: On it — will post baseline p50/p95 and cost per 100k token plots by EOD.
Priya Rao: Created ticket CS-4987 and added the plan/actions. I will DM Leah the calendar invite once Alex confirms widgets. Thanks all — keeping this tight given the renewal timeline. :pray:
